editorial:
You join Greg Heffley as his family packs up for a long drive to Meemaw’s 90th birthday, but Greg has a secret plan to sneak off to a video gaming convention. The trip quickly turns into a messy, silly adventure full of wrong turns, sibling fights, embarrassing stops, and one bad decision after another. It feels like a loud family road trip movie made for kids, with bright energy, fast jokes, and plenty of goofy moments that keep the story moving.

The cast keeps things moving, and the road trip chaos gives you lots to laugh at, especially if you enjoy silly family humor and harmless mischief. The downside is that some jokes lean on gross-out gags, and the story can feel thin for adults who want more heart. Still, younger viewers will likely have a good time, and it works well as a light family pick. Watch it with the kids, maybe streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray if you want a physical copy.
endingExplained: In the end, Greg’s gaming-convention plan falls apart, but the family still reaches Meemaw’s birthday celebration after a long, messy trip. After all the travel disasters, they learn to stick together, and Greg accepts that the trip was not what he wanted but still gives him a funny story to remember. The final scenes show the Heffleys reunited, laughing, and moving on from the chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family road trip comedies and kid-friendly humor.
